name: iBukas Solar Energy
description: This project is a robust solar inverter management calculator system which will focus primarily on calculating load for a house hold and recommending the right type of system.

name: eBuy Rental Homes
description: eBuy Homes is a Real Estate Broker Startup, and this is the first version of the proposed eBuy Mobile Application and it is aimed at simply listing valid and available housing properties.

name: PharmaCheck Telegram APP
description: The project consists of a Telegram Bot Authentication System, a Prescription API Service, and a Frontend Application built using React. The project allows users to interact with the system via Telegram for authentication and provides prescription services through a web-based application.

name: iLearning
description: A complete digital school platform for Nigerian private schools. It runs the school's public website (home, about, services, staff, terms) and the DIOS - a Digital Institution Operating System with logins and a dedicated dashboard for every role in the school.

name: Sentra Finance
description: A Web3 savings and staking platform built on the Sui blockchain. Lock your tokens, earn yield, and withdraw on your terms, all from a self-custodial dApp with a polished mobile-first interface.

name: Sarcastic Geeks Trybe
description: This project is an official community project for the Sarcastic Geeks Trybe, and with special contributions from Trybe leads, among other outsourced resources.

name: Project Didi
description: Who is Didi? A digital partner who runs on this machine. Didi is voice-first and agent-driven. Today she plays the archivist for a Marvel movie & series archive, and she's built to grow into a dev, data, and sales crew - all local, all orchestrated by her, with you pulling the trigger on anything external.

name: Find Me
description:
FindMe lets you search LinkedIn for targeted profiles using your own LinkedIn session cookies. No APIs, no third-party data brokers, no cloud dependency, no paid services. Everything runs locally.

Download and run - no terminal, no Node.js, no technical knowledge needed. Built with Electron, packaged as a native macOS or Windows app.

name: Advertorial Hub
description: The Project allows users to describe their businesses or personal projects through posts, stores, and advertisements. Users can choose from multiple subscription plans to gain different levels of access to posts, ads, storefronts, and social media promotion. Admins have full control over user management, ad approvals, and analytics.

name: Hello World Jobs
description: You know how we just apply randomly for jobs and hope to get responses? The same thing 1000 other people are doing on the same role? Well, Hello World flips the script with all amazing strategies. Get weekly radar update of newly funded startups, position yourself ahead of the job listing with Bez.ai Assistance.
